title: HTML over WebSockets: real-time SPAs with barely any JavaScript | Andros Fenollosa

content_html:
Building a SPA (Single-page Application) is a complex puzzle: a JavaScript framework that draws the view, an API serving JSON, and 2 independent codebases forced to understand each other through contracts. It is an accepted, professionalized scenario. But being a standard does not make it the only way. I want to show you another approach, one that is not new but has gained traction over the years: HTML over WebSockets.

The idea is this: instead of sending JSON and assembling the HTML in the browser, the server sends the HTML already built and the client just places it where it belongs. All the rendering logic stays in the Back-End, in a single language, with no need for contracts or an API. This pattern is known as hypermedia or HTML over the wire. What matters about how the HTML travels is that it determines the latency and the bidirectionality of the communication. There are three variants:

  • Over HTTP, request by request, like htmx or Unicorn.
  • Over SSE, opening a one-way, continuous channel from server to client, like Datastar.
  • Over WebSockets, a permanent, bidirectional channel, like Phoenix LiveView or Django LiveView.

The channel is so important that it determines the application's architecture and its communication pattern.

In this article I am going to talk about HTML over WebSockets: the real-time and bidirectional variant of the family. The one that lets you build a SPA with barely any JavaScript, in a single language, with no contracts and a single rendering engine. We will see what it is, how it works and when it pays off compared to its HTTP or SSE cousins.

Origin

Chris McCord, creator of Phoenix (the most popular framework in the Elixir ecosystem), presented at ElixirConf 2019 a technology called LiveView. In just 15 minutes he built a Twitter clone that worked in real time without adding any rendering JavaScript or a popular framework (React, Angular, Vue...) to manage the View, proving that you could stay in the Back-End and be productive with a sweet hint of good performance. Since then the solution has grown popular, inspiring other developers to build HTML-over-WebSockets implementations in other languages. You can go back to the Back-End without giving up the good parts of the Front-End.

How does it work?

Even though it might not seem so at first, JavaScript is used on the client. Its job is not to render but to create a communication channel with WebSockets and place the received HTML in the right spot. Plus other secondary tasks like animations, event handling, etc.

McCord's solution is not to send the Front-End a JSON, but HTML that needs no preprocessing. That way we move the rendering load, and all its logic, to the Back-End. OK but... how do we get the server to send us new content immediately and without making a request? Easy: with WebSockets.

Let's review the traditional system from the introduction. From the web I make an HTTP request, the browser starts the action and gets a JSON with all the raw information in response. The next step is to interpret it and build the corresponding HTML.

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Browser
    participant S as Server
    C->>S: 1. HTTP request (GET /api/article/2/) and maybe auth
    S->>S: 2. Query the DB
    S->>S: 3. Build a JSON with the article data
    S-->>C: 4. Return JSON
    C->>C: 5. Parse the JSON
    C->>C: 6. Build the HTML with its rendering engine

With HTML over WebSockets, that same request travels over a permanent channel and the response is already assembled HTML, with no JSON in between. And since the channel never closes, the server can even get ahead and send changes without the client asking.

The flow with WebSockets is now the following, ignoring the initial connection and authentication, which happen only once when the channel opens:

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Browser
    participant S as Server (Back-End)
    C->>S: 1. Sends a text: "I want /article/2/"
    S->>S: 2. Query the DB
    S->>S: 3. Render HTML with its template engine
    S-->>C: 4. Return the assembled HTML/CSS/JS
"
...
"
    C->>C: 5. Place the HTML where it belongs

Simple, elegant and fast. The client takes care of placing the HTML where it belongs and listening for events. The server handles the rest. You do not have to worry about client state or rendering logic, since everything lives in the Back-End.

The full, complex cycle, including opening the connection and authentication, would look like this:

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Browser
    participant S as Server (Back-End)
    C->>S: 1. Opens WebSocket connection and authenticates
    Note over C,S: A single persistent channel
    C->>S: 2. Sends a text: "I want /article/2/"
    S->>S: 3. Query the DB
    S->>S: 4. Render HTML with its template engine
    S-->>C: 5. Return the assembled HTML/CSS/JS
"
...
"
    C->>C: 6. Place the HTML where it belongs

changes without the client asking (broadcast)

On top of that, by its very architecture, it carries intrinsic advantages over other solutions.

What are its advantages?

  • There is only one rendering engine, cutting down complexity.
  • You do not need to build an API: the server generates HTML and sends it to the client, with no middleman.
  • State lives on the server. It is not memoryless request-response: there is a process per connected client that remembers where it is. It is the opposite of htmx, which is deliberately stateless.
  • Direct connection to the database, with no JSON or GraphQL middleman.
  • Real real-time: clients receive changes as fast as possible, without polling the server.
  • Broadcast: the server can push changes to every connected client at once. Building a chat, a dashboard or a multiplayer game comes for free.
  • Less traffic and less latency per action: a single persistent connection avoids repeating the TCP handshake and the HTTP headers on every interaction. It is not that "the WebSocket protocol is magically faster" (HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 have narrowed that gap a lot in request-response), it is that you skip the round trip and send assembled HTML.
  • Build a SPA with barely any JavaScript, without heavy frameworks like React, Angular or Vue.
  • Reasonable SEO: since the HTML is rendered on the server, the first load is indexable. Careful though, a crawler does not see the updates that arrive later over the WebSocket, so the important content must be in that first response.
  • Safer against injection: since the server renders and escapes the HTML before sending it over the channel, an attempt to sneak in a <script> travels as inert text and reaches your neighbor's screen as plain letters, not as code. The same architecture that makes a chat trivial makes it immune to XSS.

What are its drawbacks?

  • The server needs more resources: it keeps a WebSocket open and, usually, each client's state in memory. Scaling horizontally forces you to share that state (in Django, with Channels + an ASGI server + Redis as the channel layer). That said, the real problem only shows up with a large number of simultaneous clients, and careful design can mitigate it. My site has handled peaks of 600 simultaneous readers without trouble, running on hardware similar to a Raspberry Pi 3 with other services running alongside.
  • Latency: with a lot of physical latency, the "instant" feel suffers.
  • It does not work offline. If the connection drops, the site stops working. You have to design the reconnection experience and fault tolerance.
  • The initial learning curve is steeper than dropping in a <script>: running a WebSocket server is not trivial, and you have to learn to handle the LiveView pattern.

The current landscape: which frameworks exist?

The hypermedia movement already has an implementation in almost every language. Look at the transport column: the ones running over WebSocket (the LiveView pattern, real-time and bidirectional) coexist with the HTTP and SSE cousins, for when you do not need that two-way channel. You can start here:

Language Framework Transport Server push? Status
Elixir Phoenix LiveView WebSocket Yes Mature (1.x, LiveView 1.0 in Dec 2024)
Ruby Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus) HTTP + WebSocket/SSE (Streams) Yes Turbo 8 with morphing
Ruby Live / Lively (socketry) WebSocket Yes Maintained (v0.18, 2026), niche: pure WebSocket with morphdom, outside Rails, demo-focused
Python / Django Django LiveView WebSocket Yes Active (mine)
Python / Django Reactor WebSocket Yes Active
Python / Django djust WebSocket Yes New, with a Rust VDOM
Python / Django django-unicorn HTTP / AJAX No Active
Python / Django Tetra AJAX + WebSocket Yes Young, on Alpine.js
C# / .NET Blazor (Interactive Server) WebSocket (SignalR) Yes .NET 9, with render modes
PHP / Laravel Livewire 3 + Reverb WebSocket Yes Reverb, Laravel's own WebSocket server (2024)
Agnostic (JS) htmx HTTP + WS/SSE extensions Yes (extension) 2.0
Agnostic (JS) Datastar SSE Yes 1.0

SSE, the cheap option

WebSockets is powerful, but keeping a bidirectional channel open per client has a cost. And often you do not need it: if the flow is mostly server to client (notifications, a live feed, a dashboard, the tokens of an AI response), Server-Sent Events (SSE) are enough. It is the same idea, sending ready-made HTML over the wire, but over a plain HTTP channel that only goes one way.

It is the cheap option: the simplest infrastructure. By not keeping a stateful process per client, it is easier to load-balance and scale.

However, it has limitations:

  • It is one-way. Only the server pushes. If the client wants to send something, there is no channel for it: it has to make a separate HTTP request.
  • Text only. It carries UTF-8, no binary (WebSocket does).
  • Worse for heavy bidirectional work. In a chat, collaborative editing or a game, that loose back-and-forth over HTTP weighs more than an always-open WebSocket.

htmx has an almost identical implementation in spirit with its SSE extension. You declare the channel with an attribute and the HTML that arrives in each event places itself:

<div hx-ext="sse" sse-connect="/updates" sse-swap="message">
    Real-time content appears here
</div>

Under the hood it uses the browser's own EventSource, with reconnection included, and the server sends HTML fragments over text/event-stream. The same philosophy as this article, just changing the transport. Along the same lines is Datastar, which unifies Alpine-style reactivity over SSE.

The quick rule: if you need bidirectional, low-latency communication (chat, collaboration, games), WebSocket; if you only push from the server, SSE is simpler and cheaper to operate.

Final notes

HTML over WebSockets is not the answer to everything, and none of these technologies is. The transport is dictated by your problem: if you need real-time back-and-forth (a chat, a live panel, something collaborative), WebSockets; if you only push from the server, SSE; if request-and-response is enough, htmx over HTTP.

Every project is its own world, with its own quirks and limits. If you take away one thing, let it be the idea underneath: send HTML instead of JSON, stay in a single language and cross the API, the contracts and half the Front-End off your list.

Trust a good architecture, not trendy frameworks or patterns.

Sources

  • Phoenix LiveView, official docs: the canonical pattern, with per-client state on the server and diffs sent over WebSocket.
  • Phoenix LiveView 1.0 released, Phoenix blog: the 1.0 milestone (December 2024), six years after the first commit.
  • Hotwire, official site: where the name "HTML Over The Wire" comes from and why Turbo runs mostly over HTTP.
  • htmx docs: hypermedia over HTTP, deliberately stateless, with WebSockets and SSE only through extensions.
  • Turbo Handbook: Page Refreshes, on Turbo 8's morphing to update only what changed and preserve scroll and focus.
  • idiomorph, the DOM morphing library that several of these solutions use.
  • Datastar, the hypermedia framework that bets on SSE instead of WebSockets.
  • Using server-sent events, MDN: how SSE works (EventSource, automatic reconnection, Last-Event-ID, text/event-stream).
  • Laravel Reverb, Laravel's first-party WebSocket server (2024): proof that PHP also does real-time without third-party extensions.
  • ASP.NET Core Blazor render modes, Microsoft Learn: the Interactive Server mode runs over SignalR (WebSockets).

blocks.html_en: Simple, elegant and fast. The client takes care of placing the HTML where it belongs and listening for events. The server handles the rest. You do not have to worry about client state or rendering logic, since everything lives in the Back-End.

sentences.en: Simple, elegant and fast.
sentences.zh: 简单、优雅、快速。

sentences.en: The client takes care of placing the HTML where it belongs and listening for events.
sentences.zh: 客户端负责将 HTML 放置在其所属的位置并侦听事件。

sentences.en: The server handles the rest.
sentences.zh: 服务器处理剩下的事情。

sentences.en: You do not have to worry about client state or rendering logic, since everything lives in the Back-End.
sentences.zh: 您不必担心客户端状态或渲染逻辑，因为一切都位于后端。

blocks.html_en: The full, complex cycle, including opening the connection and authentication, would look like this:

sentences.en: The full, complex cycle, including opening the connection and authentication, would look like this:
sentences.zh: 完整、复杂的周期，包括打开连接和身份验证，如下所示：

blocks.html_en: On top of that, by its very architecture, it carries intrinsic advantages over other solutions.

sentences.en: On top of that, by its very architecture, it carries intrinsic advantages over other solutions.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，由于其架构本身，它比其他解决方案具有内在的优势。

sentences.en: What are its advantages?
sentences.zh: 它的优点是什么？

blocks.html_en: • There is only one rendering engine, cutting down complexity.

sentences.en: There is only one rendering engine, cutting down complexity.
sentences.zh: 只有一个渲染引擎，降低了复杂性。

blocks.html_en: • You do not need to build an API: the server generates HTML and sends it to the client, with no middleman.

sentences.en: You do not need to build an API: the server generates HTML and sends it to the client, with no middleman.
sentences.zh: 您不需要构建 API：服务器生成 HTML 并将其发送到客户端，无需中间人。

blocks.html_en: • State lives on the server. It is not memoryless request-response: there is a process per connected client that remembers where it is. It is the opposite of htmx, which is deliberately stateless.

sentences.en: State lives on the server.
sentences.zh: 状态存在于服务器上。

sentences.en: It is not memoryless request-response: there is a process per connected client that remembers where it is.
sentences.zh: 它不是无记忆的请求-响应：每个连接的客户端都有一个进程记住它在哪里。

sentences.en: It is the opposite of htmx, which is deliberately stateless.
sentences.zh: 它与htmx相反，htmx是故意无状态的。

blocks.html_en: • Direct connection to the database, with no JSON or GraphQL middleman.

sentences.en: Direct connection to the database, with no JSON or GraphQL middleman.
sentences.zh: 直接连接到数据库，没有 JSON 或 GraphQL 中间人。

blocks.html_en: • Real real-time: clients receive changes as fast as possible, without polling the server.

sentences.en: Real real-time: clients receive changes as fast as possible, without polling the server.
sentences.zh: 真正的实时：客户端尽快接收更改，无需轮询服务器。

blocks.html_en: • Broadcast: the server can push changes to every connected client at once. Building a chat, a dashboard or a multiplayer game comes for free.

sentences.en: Broadcast: the server can push changes to every connected client at once.
sentences.zh: 广播：服务器可以立即将更改推送到每个连接的客户端。

sentences.en: Building a chat, a dashboard or a multiplayer game comes for free.
sentences.zh: 构建聊天、仪表板或多人游戏都是免费的。

blocks.html_en: • Less traffic and less latency per action: a single persistent connection avoids repeating the TCP handshake and the HTTP headers on every interaction. It is not that "the WebSocket protocol is magically faster" (HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 have narrowed that gap a lot in request-response), it is that you skip the round trip and send assembled HTML.

sentences.en: Less traffic and less latency per action: a single persistent connection avoids repeating the TCP handshake and the HTTP headers on every interaction.
sentences.zh: 每个操作的流量和延迟更少：单个持久连接可避免每次交互时重复 TCP 握手和 HTTP 标头。

sentences.en: It is not that "the WebSocket protocol is magically faster" (HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 have narrowed that gap a lot in request-response), it is that you skip the round trip and send assembled HTML.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说“WebSocket 协议神奇地更快”（HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3 在请求响应方面大大缩小了差距），而是您跳过了往返并发送了组装的 HTML。

blocks.html_en: • Build a SPA with barely any JavaScript, without heavy frameworks like React, Angular or Vue.

sentences.en: Build a SPA with barely any JavaScript, without heavy frameworks like React, Angular or Vue.
sentences.zh: 几乎不需要任何 JavaScript 即可构建 SPA，无需使用 React、Angular 或 Vue 等重型框架。

blocks.html_en: • Reasonable SEO: since the HTML is rendered on the server, the first load is indexable. Careful though, a crawler does not see the updates that arrive later over the WebSocket, so the important content must be in that first response.

sentences.en: Reasonable SEO: since the HTML is rendered on the server, the first load is indexable.
sentences.zh: 合理的 SEO：由于 HTML 是在服务器上呈现的，因此第一次加载是可索引的。

sentences.en: Careful though, a crawler does not see the updates that arrive later over the WebSocket, so the important content must be in that first response.
sentences.zh: 但要小心，爬虫程序看不到稍后通过 WebSocket 到达的更新，因此重要内容必须位于第一个响应中。

blocks.html_en: • Safer against injection: since the server renders and escapes the HTML before sending it over the channel, an attempt to sneak in a <script> travels as inert text and reaches your neighbor's screen as plain letters, not as code. The same architecture that makes a chat trivial makes it immune to XSS.

sentences.en: Safer against injection: since the server renders and escapes the HTML before sending it over the channel, an attempt to sneak in a <script> travels as inert text and reaches your neighbor's screen as plain letters, not as code.
sentences.zh: 更安全地防止注入：由于服务器在通过通道发送 HTML 之前先渲染并转义 HTML，因此尝试潜入 <script> 会以惰性文本的形式传播，并以纯字母（而不是代码）的形式到达邻居的屏幕。

sentences.en: The same architecture that makes a chat trivial makes it immune to XSS.
sentences.zh: 使聊天变得简单的相同架构使其免受 XSS 影响。

sentences.en: What are its drawbacks?
sentences.zh: 它有什么缺点？

blocks.html_en: • The server needs more resources: it keeps a WebSocket open and, usually, each client's state in memory. Scaling horizontally forces you to share that state (in Django, with Channels + an ASGI server + Redis as the channel layer). That said, the real problem only shows up with a large number of simultaneous clients, and careful design can mitigate it. My site has handled peaks of 600 simultaneous readers without trouble, running on hardware similar to a Raspberry Pi 3 with other services running alongside.

sentences.en: The server needs more resources: it keeps a WebSocket open and, usually, each client's state in memory.
sentences.zh: 服务器需要更多资源：它保持 WebSocket 打开，并且通常将每个客户端的状态保存在内存中。

sentences.en: Scaling horizontally forces you to share that state (in Django, with Channels + an ASGI server + Redis as the channel layer).
sentences.zh: 水平扩展迫使您共享该状态（在 Django 中，使用 Channels + ASGI 服务器 + Redis 作为通道层）。

sentences.en: That said, the real problem only shows up with a large number of simultaneous clients, and careful design can mitigate it.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，真正的问题只有在大量并发客户端出现时才会出现，而仔细的设计可以缓解它。

sentences.en: My site has handled peaks of 600 simultaneous readers without trouble, running on hardware similar to a Raspberry Pi 3 with other services running alongside.
sentences.zh: 我的网站可以毫无问题地处理 600 个并发读取器的峰值，在类似于 Raspberry Pi 3 的硬件上运行，并同时运行其他服务。

blocks.html_en: • Latency: with a lot of physical latency, the "instant" feel suffers.

sentences.en: Latency: with a lot of physical latency, the "instant" feel suffers.
sentences.zh: 延迟：由于存在大量物理延迟，“即时”感觉会受到影响。

blocks.html_en: • It does not work offline. If the connection drops, the site stops working. You have to design the reconnection experience and fault tolerance.

sentences.en: It does not work offline.
sentences.zh: 它无法离线工作。

sentences.en: If the connection drops, the site stops working.
sentences.zh: 如果连接断开，站点将停止工作。

sentences.en: You have to design the reconnection experience and fault tolerance.
sentences.zh: 你必须设计重连体验和容错能力。

blocks.html_en: • The initial learning curve is steeper than dropping in a <script>: running a WebSocket server is not trivial, and you have to learn to handle the LiveView pattern.

sentences.en: The initial learning curve is steeper than dropping in a <script>: running a WebSocket server is not trivial, and you have to learn to handle the LiveView pattern.
sentences.zh: 最初的学习曲线比放入 <script> 更陡峭：运行 WebSocket 服务器并不简单，您必须学会处理 LiveView 模式。

sentences.en: The current landscape: which frameworks exist?
sentences.zh: 当前情况：存在哪些框架？

Look at the transport column: the ones running over WebSocket (the LiveView pattern, real-time and bidirectional) coexist with the HTTP and SSE cousins, for when you do not need that two-way channel. You can start here:

blocks.html_en: WebSockets is powerful, but keeping a bidirectional channel open per client has a cost. And often you do not need it: if the flow is mostly server to client (notifications, a live feed, a dashboard, the tokens of an AI response), Server-Sent Events (SSE) are enough. It is the same idea, sending ready-made HTML over the wire, but over a plain HTTP channel that only goes one way.

sentences.en: WebSockets is powerful, but keeping a bidirectional channel open per client has a cost.
sentences.zh: WebSocket 功能强大，但保持每个客户端打开双向通道是有成本的。

sentences.en: And often you do not need it: if the flow is mostly server to client (notifications, a live feed, a dashboard, the tokens of an AI response), Server-Sent Events (SSE) are enough.
sentences.zh: 通常您不需要它：如果流程主要是服务器到客户端（通知、实时反馈、仪表板、AI 响应的令牌），服务器发送事件 (SSE) 就足够了。

sentences.en: It is the same idea, sending ready-made HTML over the wire, but over a plain HTTP channel that only goes one way.
sentences.zh: 这是相同的想法，通过线路发送现成的 HTML，但通过仅单向的普通 HTTP 通道。

blocks.html_en: It is the cheap option: the simplest infrastructure. By not keeping a stateful process per client, it is easier to load-balance and scale.

sentences.en: It is the cheap option: the simplest infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 这是最便宜的选择：最简单的基础设施。

sentences.en: By not keeping a stateful process per client, it is easier to load-balance and scale.
sentences.zh: 通过不为每个客户端保留有状态的进程，可以更轻松地进行负载平衡和扩展。

sentences.en: However, it has limitations:
sentences.zh: 然而，它也有局限性：

blocks.html_en: • It is one-way. Only the server pushes. If the client wants to send something, there is no channel for it: it has to make a separate HTTP request.

sentences.en: It is one-way.
sentences.zh: 这是单向的。

sentences.en: Only the server pushes.
sentences.zh: 只有服务器推送。

sentences.en: If the client wants to send something, there is no channel for it: it has to make a separate HTTP request.
sentences.zh: 如果客户端想要发送某些内容，则没有通道：它必须发出单独的 HTTP 请求。

blocks.html_en: • Text only. It carries UTF-8, no binary (WebSocket does).

sentences.en: Text only.
sentences.zh: 仅文本。

sentences.en: It carries UTF-8, no binary (WebSocket does).
sentences.zh: 它携带 UTF-8，没有二进制文件（WebSocket 有）。

blocks.html_en: • Worse for heavy bidirectional work. In a chat, collaborative editing or a game, that loose back-and-forth over HTTP weighs more than an always-open WebSocket.

sentences.en: Worse for heavy bidirectional work.
sentences.zh: 对于繁重的双向工作来说更糟。

sentences.en: In a chat, collaborative editing or a game, that loose back-and-forth over HTTP weighs more than an always-open WebSocket.
sentences.zh: 在聊天、协作编辑或游戏中，通过 HTTP 进行的松散的来回传输比始终打开的 WebSocket 更重要。

blocks.html_en: htmx has an almost identical implementation in spirit with its SSE extension. You declare the channel with an attribute and the HTML that arrives in each event places itself:

sentences.en: htmx has an almost identical implementation in spirit with its SSE extension.
sentences.zh: htmx 与其 SSE 扩展在精神上有几乎相同的实现。

sentences.en: You declare the channel with an attribute and the HTML that arrives in each event places itself:
sentences.zh: 您可以使用一个属性来声明通道，并且到达每个事件的 HTML 会自行放置：

blocks.html_en: Under the hood it uses the browser's own EventSource, with reconnection included, and the server sends HTML fragments over text/event-stream. The same philosophy as this article, just changing the transport. Along the same lines is Datastar, which unifies Alpine-style reactivity over SSE.

sentences.en: Under the hood it uses the browser's own EventSource, with reconnection included, and the server sends HTML fragments over text/event-stream.
sentences.zh: 在底层，它使用浏览器自己的 EventSource，包括重新连接，并且服务器通过文本/事件流发送 HTML 片段。

sentences.en: The same philosophy as this article, just changing the transport.
sentences.zh: 与本文的理念相同，只是改变了传输方式。

sentences.en: Along the same lines is Datastar, which unifies Alpine-style reactivity over SSE.
sentences.zh: Datastar 也遵循同样的思路，它在 SSE 上统一了 Alpine 风格的反应性。

blocks.html_en: The quick rule: if you need bidirectional, low-latency communication (chat, collaboration, games), WebSocket; if you only push from the server, SSE is simpler and cheaper to operate.

sentences.en: The quick rule: if you need bidirectional, low-latency communication (chat, collaboration, games), WebSocket; if you only push from the server, SSE is simpler and cheaper to operate.
sentences.zh: 快速规则：如果您需要双向、低延迟通信（聊天、协作、游戏），则使用 WebSocket；如果你只从服务器推送，SSE 操作起来更简单、更便宜。

sentences.en: Final notes
sentences.zh: 最后的笔记

blocks.html_en: HTML over WebSockets is not the answer to everything, and none of these technologies is. The transport is dictated by your problem: if you need real-time back-and-forth (a chat, a live panel, something collaborative), WebSockets; if you only push from the server, SSE; if request-and-response is enough, htmx over HTTP.

sentences.en: HTML over WebSockets is not the answer to everything, and none of these technologies is.
sentences.zh: HTML over WebSockets 并不能解决所有问题，而且这些技术都不能解决所有问题。

sentences.en: The transport is dictated by your problem: if you need real-time back-and-forth (a chat, a live panel, something collaborative), WebSockets; if you only push from the server, SSE; if request-and-response is enough, htmx over HTTP.
sentences.zh: 传输方式取决于您的问题：如果您需要实时来回（聊天、实时面板、协作），则 WebSockets；如果你只从服务器推送，SSE；如果请求和响应就足够了，则可以通过 HTTP 进行 htmx。

blocks.html_en: Every project is its own world, with its own quirks and limits. If you take away one thing, let it be the idea underneath: send HTML instead of JSON, stay in a single language and cross the API, the contracts and half the Front-End off your list.

sentences.en: Every project is its own world, with its own quirks and limits.
sentences.zh: 每个项目都是它自己的世界，有它自己的怪癖和限制。

sentences.en: If you take away one thing, let it be the idea underneath: send HTML instead of JSON, stay in a single language and cross the API, the contracts and half the Front-End off your list.
sentences.zh: 如果你拿走一件事，那就让它成为下面的想法：发送 HTML 而不是 JSON，保持单一语言并跨越 API、合约和一半的前端。

blocks.html_en: Trust a good architecture, not trendy frameworks or patterns.

sentences.en: Trust a good architecture, not trendy frameworks or patterns.
sentences.zh: 相信好的架构，而不是流行的框架或模式。

sentences.en: ASP.NET Core Blazor render modes, Microsoft Learn: the Interactive Server mode runs over SignalR (WebSockets).
sentences.zh: ASP.NET Core Blazor 渲染模式，Microsoft Learn：交互式服务器模式通过 SignalR (WebSockets) 运行。

content_html_zh:
构建 SPA（单页应用程序）是一个复杂的难题：绘制视图的 JavaScript 框架、服务 JSON 的 API 以及被迫通过合约相互理解的 2 个独立代码库。 这是一个被接受的、专业化的场景。 但成为标准并不意味着它是唯一的方法。 我想向您展示另一种方法，这种方法并不新鲜，但多年来已经受到关注：HTML over WebSockets。

这个想法是这样的：服务器不是发送 JSON 并在浏览器中组装 HTML，而是发送已经构建的 HTML，客户端只需将其放置在其所属的位置即可。 所有渲染逻辑都以单一语言保留在后端，无需合约或 API。 这种模式称为超媒体或 HTML。 HTML 传输方式的重要之处在于它决定了通信的延迟和双向性。 有以下三种变体：

  • 通过 HTTP，逐个请求，如 htmx 或 Unicorn。
  • 通过SSE，打开一个从服务器到客户端的单向、连续通道，就像Datastar一样。
  • 通过 WebSockets，一种永久的双向通道，例如 Phoenix LiveView 或 Django LiveView。

通道非常重要，它决定了应用程序的架构及其通信模式。

在本文中，我将讨论基于 WebSockets 的 HTML：该系列的实时和双向变体。 它可以让您几乎不需要任何 JavaScript，使用单一语言构建 SPA，无需合约和单一渲染引擎。 我们将了解它是什么、如何工作以及与 HTTP 或 SSE 同类产品相比何时获得回报。

起源

Phoenix（Elixir 生态系统中最受欢迎的框架）的创建者 Chris McCord 在 ElixirConf 2019 上展示了一项名为 LiveView 的技术。 他在短短 15 分钟内构建了一个 Twitter 克隆，可以实时运行，无需添加任何渲染 JavaScript 或流行框架（React、Angular、Vue...） 管理视图，证明您可以留在后端并通过良好性能的甜蜜暗示来提高工作效率。 从那时起，该解决方案变得越来越流行，激励其他开发人员用其他语言构建 HTML-over-WebSockets 实现。 你可以回到后端而不放弃前端的好部分。

它是如何运作的？

尽管乍一看似乎并非如此，但 JavaScript 是在客户端上使用的。 它的工作不是渲染，而是创建与 WebSocket 的通信通道，并将接收到的 HTML 放置在正确的位置。 加上其他次要任务，如动画、事件处理等。

McCord 的解决方案不是向前端发送 JSON，而是向前端发送不需要预处理的 HTML。 这样我们就可以将渲染负载及其所有逻辑移至后端。 好吧但是... 我们如何让服务器立即向我们发送新内容而不发出请求？ 简单：使用 WebSocket。

让我们从引言中回顾一下传统的系统。 我从网络发出 HTTP 请求，浏览器启动操作并获取包含所有原始信息的 JSON 作为响应。 下一步是解释它并构建相应的 HTML。

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Browser
    participant S as Server
    C->>S: 1. HTTP request (GET /api/article/2/) and maybe auth
    S->>S: 2. Query the DB
    S->>S: 3. Build a JSON with the article data
    S-->>C: 4. Return JSON
    C->>C: 5. Parse the JSON
    C->>C: 6. Build the HTML with its rendering engine

通过 WebSockets 上的 HTML，相同的请求通过永久通道传输，并且响应已经组装成 HTML，中间没有 JSON。 由于通道永远不会关闭，服务器甚至可以在没有客户端请求的情况下提前发送更改。

WebSockets 的流程如下，忽略初始连接和身份验证，这仅在通道打开时发生一次：

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Browser
    participant S as Server (Back-End)
    C->>S: 1. Sends a text: "I want /article/2/"
    S->>S: 2. Query the DB
    S->>S: 3. Render HTML with its template engine
    S-->>C: 4. Return the assembled HTML/CSS/JS
"
...
"
    C->>C: 5. Place the HTML where it belongs

简单、优雅、快速。 客户端负责将 HTML 放置在其所属的位置并侦听事件。 服务器处理剩下的事情。 您不必担心客户端状态或渲染逻辑，因为一切都位于后端。

完整、复杂的周期，包括打开连接和身份验证，如下所示：

sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Browser
    participant S as Server (Back-End)
    C->>S: 1. Opens WebSocket connection and authenticates
    Note over C,S: A single persistent channel
    C->>S: 2. Sends a text: "I want /article/2/"
    S->>S: 3. Query the DB
    S->>S: 4. Render HTML with its template engine
    S-->>C: 5. Return the assembled HTML/CSS/JS
"
...
"
    C->>C: 6. Place the HTML where it belongs
    Note over S,C: The server can also push
changes without the client asking (broadcast)

最重要的是，由于其架构本身，它比其他解决方案具有内在的优势。

它的优点是什么？

  • 只有一个渲染引擎，降低了复杂性。
  • 您不需要构建 API：服务器生成 HTML 并将其发送到客户端，无需中间人。
  • 状态存在于服务器上。 它不是无记忆的请求-响应：每个连接的客户端都有一个进程记住它在哪里。 它与htmx相反，htmx是故意无状态的。
  • 直接连接到数据库，没有 JSON 或 GraphQL 中间人。
  • 真正的实时：客户端尽快接收更改，无需轮询服务器。
  • 广播：服务器可以立即将更改推送到每个连接的客户端。 构建聊天、仪表板或多人游戏都是免费的。
  • 每个操作的流量和延迟更少：单个持久连接可避免每次交互时重复 TCP 握手和 HTTP 标头。 这并不是说“WebSocket 协议神奇地更快”（HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3 在请求响应方面大大缩小了差距），而是您跳过了往返并发送了组装的 HTML。
  • 几乎不需要任何 JavaScript 即可构建 SPA，无需使用 React、Angular 或 Vue 等重型框架。
  • 合理的 SEO：由于 HTML 是在服务器上呈现的，因此第一次加载是可索引的。 但要小心，爬虫程序看不到稍后通过 WebSocket 到达的更新，因此重要内容必须位于第一个响应中。
  • 更安全地防止注入：由于服务器在通过通道发送 HTML 之前先渲染并转义 HTML，因此尝试潜入 <script> 会以惰性文本的形式传播，并以纯字母（而不是代码）的形式到达邻居的屏幕。 使聊天变得简单的相同架构使其免受 XSS 影响。

它有什么缺点？

  • 服务器需要更多资源：它保持 WebSocket 打开，并且通常将每个客户端的状态保存在内存中。 水平扩展迫使您共享该状态（在 Django 中，使用 Channels + ASGI 服务器 + Redis 作为通道层）。 也就是说，真正的问题只有在大量并发客户端出现时才会出现，而仔细的设计可以缓解它。 我的网站可以毫无问题地处理 600 个并发读取器的峰值，在类似于 Raspberry Pi 3 的硬件上运行，并同时运行其他服务。
  • 延迟：由于存在大量物理延迟，“即时”感觉会受到影响。
  • 它无法离线工作。 如果连接断开，站点将停止工作。 你必须设计重连体验和容错能力。
  • 最初的学习曲线比放入 <script> 更陡峭：运行 WebSocket 服务器并不简单，您必须学会处理 LiveView 模式。

当前情况：存在哪些框架？

超媒体运动已经在几乎所有语言中得到实施。 查看传输列：当您不需要双向通道时，通过 WebSocket（LiveView 模式，实时和双向）运行的传输列与 HTTP 和 SSE 同类共存。 您可以从这里开始：

语言 框架 运输 服务器推送？ 地位
灵丹妙药 凤凰城直播 WebSocket Yes 成熟（1.x，2024 年 12 月推出 LiveView 1.0）
Ruby Hotwire（涡轮+刺激） HTTP + WebSocket/SSE（流） Yes Turbo 8 具有变形功能
Ruby Live/Lively（插座） WebSocket Yes 已维护（v0.18，2026），利基：具有 morphdom 的纯 WebSocket，Rails 之外，以演示为中心
蟒蛇 / 姜戈 Django 实时查看 WebSocket Yes 活跃（我的）
蟒蛇 / 姜戈 反应堆 WebSocket Yes 积极的
蟒蛇 / 姜戈 djust WebSocket Yes 新的，带有 Rust VDOM
蟒蛇 / 姜戈 Django 独角兽 HTTP/AJAX No 积极的
蟒蛇 / 姜戈 Tetra AJAX + WebSocket Yes 年轻，在 Alpine.js 上
C# / .NET Blazor（交互式服务器） WebSocket（信号R） Yes .NET 9，具有渲染模式
PHP / Laravel Livewire 3 + 混响 WebSocket Yes Reverb，Laravel 自己的 WebSocket 服务器（2024）
不可知论者 (JS) htmx HTTP + WS/SSE 扩展 是（扩展） 2.0
不可知论者 (JS) 数据星 SSE Yes 1.0

上交所，便宜的选择

WebSocket 功能强大，但保持每个客户端打开双向通道是有成本的。 通常您不需要它：如果流程主要是服务器到客户端（通知、实时反馈、仪表板、AI 响应的令牌），服务器发送事件 (SSE) 就足够了。 这是相同的想法，通过线路发送现成的 HTML，但通过仅单向的普通 HTTP 通道。

这是最便宜的选择：最简单的基础设施。 通过不为每个客户端保留有状态的进程，可以更轻松地进行负载平衡和扩展。

然而，它也有局限性：

  • 这是单向的。 只有服务器推送。 如果客户端想要发送某些内容，则没有通道：它必须发出单独的 HTTP 请求。
  • 仅文本。 它携带 UTF-8，没有二进制文件（WebSocket 有）。
  • 对于繁重的双向工作来说更糟。 在聊天、协作编辑或游戏中，通过 HTTP 进行的松散的来回传输比始终打开的 WebSocket 更重要。

htmx 与其 SSE 扩展在精神上有几乎相同的实现。 您可以使用一个属性来声明通道，并且到达每个事件的 HTML 会自行放置：

<div hx-ext="sse" sse-connect="/updates" sse-swap="message">
    Real-time content appears here
</div>

在底层，它使用浏览器自己的 EventSource，包括重新连接，并且服务器通过文本/事件流发送 HTML 片段。 与本文的理念相同，只是改变了传输方式。 Datastar 也遵循同样的思路，它在 SSE 上统一了 Alpine 风格的反应性。

快速规则：如果您需要双向、低延迟通信（聊天、协作、游戏），则使用 WebSocket；如果你只从服务器推送，SSE 操作起来更简单、更便宜。

最后的笔记

HTML over WebSockets 并不能解决所有问题，而且这些技术都不能解决所有问题。 传输方式取决于您的问题：如果您需要实时来回（聊天、实时面板、协作），则 WebSockets；如果你只从服务器推送，SSE；如果请求和响应就足够了，则可以通过 HTTP 进行 htmx。

每个项目都是它自己的世界，有它自己的怪癖和限制。 如果你拿走一件事，那就让它成为下面的想法：发送 HTML 而不是 JSON，保持单一语言并跨越 API、合约和一半的前端。

相信好的架构，而不是流行的框架或模式。

来源

  • Phoenix LiveView，官方文档：规范模式，服务器上每个客户端的状态以及通过 WebSocket 发送的差异。
  • Phoenix LiveView 1.0 发布，Phoenix 博客：1.0 里程碑（2024 年 12 月），距首次提交六年。
  • Hotwire，官方网站：“HTML Over The Wire”名称的由来以及 Turbo 主要通过 HTTP 运行的原因。
  • htmx 文档：基于 HTTP 的超媒体，故意无状态，仅通过扩展使用 WebSockets 和 SSE。
  • Turbo 手册：页面刷新，关于 Turbo 8 的变形，仅更新更改的内容并保留滚动和焦点。
  • idiomorph，其中一些解决方案使用的 DOM 变形库。
  • Datastar，一个押注于 SSE 而不是 WebSocket 的超媒体框架。
  • 使用服务器发送的事件，MDN：SSE 的工作原理（EventSource、自动重新连接、Last-Event-ID、文本/事件流）。
  • Laravel Reverb，Laravel 的第一方 WebSocket 服务器（2024）：证明 PHP 也可以在没有第三方扩展的情况下实现实时。
  • ASP.NET Core Blazor 渲染模式，Microsoft Learn：交互式服务器模式通过 SignalR (WebSockets) 运行。
